title: Dónde están los ladrones?
desc_lfm_artist: Shakira Isabel Mebarak Ripoll is a Colombian singer. Born and raised in Barranquilla, She made her recording debut with Sony Music Colombia at the age of 13. Following the commercial failure of her first two albums, Magia (1991) and Peligro (1993), she rose to prominence in Hispanic countries with her next albums, Pies Descalzos (1995) and Dónde Están los Ladrones? (1998). She entered the English-language market with her fifth album, Laundry Service (2001), which sold over 13 million copies worldwide.

title: ORQUÍDEAS
desc_lfm_album: ORQUÍDEAS is the fourth studio album and second Spanish-language album by Kali Uchis, released on January 12, 2024, through Geffen Records. It features guest appearances by Peso Pluma, El Alfa, JT, KAROL G and Rauw Alejandro. The album debuted at number two on the US Billboard 200, marking Uchis' highest-charting album. The album was announced following Uchis' reveal in 2022 that she had two ready-to-release albums, one in English and one in Spanish. title: Gemelo
desc_lfm_artist:
Angélica Garcia is an American singer-songwriter currently based in Richmond, Virginia. She has released three studio albums: Medicine for Birds (2016), Cha Cha Palace (2020) and Gemelo (2024). Her song "Jícama" became widely known when US President Barack Obama selected the track for his 2019 year-end list.

Born in Los Angeles, California, and raised in El Monte in the San Gabriel Valley east of the city. Garcia studied creative writing at Cooperative Arts High in New Haven

title: Un verano sin ti
desc_lfm_album: Un Verano Sin Ti is the fourth studio album from Puerto Rican rapper and singer Bad Bunny. Released on May 6th 2022, it features guest appearances from Chencho Corleone, Jhay Cortez, Tony Dize, Rauw Alejandro, Bomba Estéreo, The Marías and Buscabulla. Comprising twenty-three tracks, the album is primarily a reggaeton, cumbia and indie pop record, and contains guest appearances from Chencho Corleone, Jhay Cortez, Tony Dize, Rauw Alejandro, Bomba Estéreo, the Marías and Buscabulla. desc_lfm_artist: Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio (born March 10, 1994), known professionally as Bad Bunny, is a Puerto Rican rapper and singer. He is recognized as a leading figure in Latin trap and has played a significant role in popularizing Spanish-language rap in global mainstream music. Bad Bunny became the first non-English-language artist to be Spotify's most-streamed artist of the year, achieving this distinction in three consecutive years from 2020 to 2022. His 2022 album "Un Verano Sin Ti" holds the record as the most-streamed album on Spotify.
